claim_limit: Post-hoc structural diagnosis only. These counterfactuals cannot pass the empirical or blind-validation gates, change frozen acceptance thresholds, or authorize parameter fitting.

common_settings.production_parameters: reuse the recorded failed production fit without refitting

source_timing.offset_semantics: candidate source at target row t is copied from published row t plus offset; positive values advance a later source row
source_timing.support_rule: the same non-zero source offset must reduce whole-building unexplained-gain MAE by at least 10 percent in both periods

heater_distribution.support_rule: an alternative is material only if it reduces whole-building unexplained-gain MAE by at least 10 percent in both periods; the published 0.7 value remains authoritative regardless

initial_mass_state.support_rule: initial-state uncertainty is material if the post-warmup whole-building or attic unexplained-gain MAE span is at least 10 percent of baseline in either period

capacity_allocation.support_rule: floor-area allocation is supported only if it reduces both whole-building and attic unexplained-gain MAE by at least 10 percent in both periods without refitting total capacity

representation_checks: component-specific roof, floor, ceiling, wall, window, and thermal-bridge topology
decision_rule: Report every candidate, including negative results. A diagnostic finding may prioritize implementation work but cannot be applied as a fitted correction.
